query: Which small-sample corrections (Satterthwaite, Kenward–Roger, Welch) most improve power accuracy across unbalanced cluster-size distributions?

response.query: Which small-sample corrections (Satterthwaite, Kenward–Roger, Welch) most improve power accuracy across unbalanced cluster-size distributions?
response.answer: The Kenward–Roger method most improves power accuracy across unbalanced cluster-size distributions. Satterthwaite and Welch are also effective but less so than Kenward–Roger.
